@graph.headline: PPC for Home Builders
@graph.description: Evaluate PPC for home builders with offer, policy, landing-page, tracking, lead-quality, budget, and sales-response gates before any campaign activation.

mainEntity.name: Is PPC a fast way for home builders to get leads?

acceptedAnswer.text: PPC can create visibility quickly after an approved campaign activates, but lead timing, volume, quality, cost, and sales outcomes are not guaranteed. Readiness, demand, competition, policy, budget, landing pages, and follow-up all matter.

mainEntity.name: What landing page should a home builder ad use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use the most relevant approved page for the ad's promise and search intent. It should explain fit, geography, proof, the next step, and what happens after the inquiry.

mainEntity.name: What should count as a PPC conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: Count a clearly defined, tested action such as a valid consultation request, while keeping platform events separate from sales-confirmed lead quality and pipeline outcomes.

mainEntity.name: Can home builders use audience targeting in Google Ads?

acceptedAnswer.text: Available and permitted targeting depends on the campaign, offer, account, geography, and current policy classification. Review the live platform policy and account controls before using any audience.

mainEntity.name: How should a builder set a PPC budget?

acceptedAnswer.text: Leadership should approve a ceiling, dates, geography, offer, pacing rules, change authority, and stop conditions based on current account evidence. This guide does not prescribe a spend amount.
